numeric_semantics: append-only transparent newtypes; zero is reserved; reinterpretation requires a new SDK major
unknown_values: preserve for diagnostics, reject before invocation when required semantics are unknown

ownership.plugin_objects: SDK-owned abi_stable RBox/RArc wrappers; plugin allocator and SDK destructor
ownership.host_values: host-owned copies; never retain borrowed callback inputs
ownership.drop_thread: creating worker unless the ABI object explicitly declares Send+Sync
ownership.dll_lifetime: process resident; all plugin objects drain before terminal shutdown; unload is forbidden

panic_policy: panic=unwind only; SDK adapters catch and fault-latch; panic=abort fingerprint mismatch is rejected before callback
